title: NYC Changing Station Explorer
description: Public changing-table locations across New York City are mapped from NYC Open Data restroom records and grouped by reported placement.

media.label: Animated changing-table map
media.alt: NYC borough map of changing tables reported in public restrooms

title: Waterfront Walks
description: Recorded waterfront paths in Jersey City and Brooklyn are classified by surface and walking-permission tags from OpenStreetMap.

media.label: Waterfront paths
media.alt: Jersey City and Brooklyn waterfront paths classified by recorded surface

title: Inside the Park
description: Activity spaces and paths in three Jersey City parks are mapped from OpenStreetMap polygons and tags. Separate panels use metric scales and a shared location map.

media.label: Three-park map
media.alt: Activity polygons and paths in Hamilton, Lafayette, and Berry Lane parks

title: Clusters of Play
description: Playgrounds and licensed childcare centers in Jersey City and Hoboken are mapped from OpenStreetMap and NJ licensing records. Grouped playgrounds are linked to centers within a 400 m straight-line threshold.

media.label: Animated proximity map
media.alt: Playgrounds and nearby licensed childcare centers in Jersey City and Hoboken

downloads.label: Static PNG
downloads.alt: Playgrounds and nearby licensed childcare centers in Jersey City and Hoboken

title: Seeing New York from the Water
description: Lower Manhattan is illustrated from a waterfront viewpoint using NYC building footprints and roof heights. Separate silhouette layers move at different speeds to create a depth effect.

media.label: Animated skyline and viewing locator
media.alt: Layered Lower Manhattan skyline and its geographic viewing locator

title: A Changing Harbor Edge
description: A NYPL harbor chart cataloged as possibly dating to 1844 is overlaid with NYC DCP and OpenStreetMap shorelines. A six-parameter affine transform aligns the historical scan with modern mapped geometry.

media.label: Historical shoreline overlay
media.alt: Historical New York Harbor chart overlaid with modern mapped shorelines

title: A City at Stroller Speed
description: An imagined neighborhood around Rittenhouse Square is based on OpenStreetMap street and park geometry. Vector-drawn scenes show space for caregivers, children, and everyday activities.

media.label: Illustrated neighborhood map
media.alt: Illustrated stroller-paced neighborhood around the real Rittenhouse Square boundary

title: A Landscape of Surnames
description: Taiwan's twenty most common surnames are shown as population-scaled glyphs using MOI household-registration counts. Schematic placement is combined with NOAA ETOPO depth bands.

media.label: Surname landscape with final bathymetry
media.alt: Population-scaled Taiwanese surname glyphs over a schematic island and genuine depth bands

title: Heritage Across East Asia
description: UNESCO cultural heritage locations across East Asia are classified by documented historical formation phases. Official site records and reviewed evidence support the component-level map and interactive timeline.

media.label: Historical heritage map
media.alt: East Asian UNESCO cultural heritage locations colored by historical formation phases

title: Where Sounds Ripple
description: Recorded pronunciations of “水” across Cantonese-speaking communities are mapped from Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang survey records. Initials are encoded by color and finals by categorical wave patterns over Natural Earth and NOAA ETOPO geography.

media.label: Animated pronunciation map
media.alt: Recorded pronunciations of water across Cantonese-speaking communities, encoded as wave patterns

downloads.label: Static PNG
downloads.alt: Recorded pronunciations of water across Cantonese-speaking communities, encoded as wave patterns

title: The Shape of Wind
description: ERA5 10 m wind fields from 15 January and 5 September 2025 are shown over East Asia and the western Pacific. RK4 streamlines and brightness animation follow each fixed snapshot, with Natural Earth land as context.

title: Where Night Comes From
description: Late-evening home-area associations for the 40th Street area are mapped from Advan Neighborhood Patterns+ records for August and September 2025. CBG-level contributions and statistical links represent scaled associations, not unique visitors or observed routes.
